subject.title: fix(gateway): force exit on zombie shutdown + 503 healthz during shutdown

question: Should Gateway adopt this PR's forced post-shutdown `process.exit(0)` watchdog, `OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_POST_SHUTDOWN_EXIT_TIMEOUT_MS` env surface, and `/healthz?strict=1` shutdown probe contract as the production recovery policy for zombie shutdowns?
rationale: The patch looks correct and well covered, but it deliberately changes process-lifecycle behavior and adds an operator timeout knob, which is a Gateway product/operations contract rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept the recovery contract
options.body: Merge after final exact-head review/CI because the branch preserves public `/healthz`, covers in-process restart, and directly addresses the observed zombie outage.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Ask for a revised branch that removes or hides the env knob, changes the timeout/default, or further constrains where forced exit can run.

options.title: Defer to broader launchd lifecycle work
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want all supervised restart and KeepAlive semantics settled together with the canonical launchd policy issue.

recommendation.title: Accept the recovery contract
recommendation.body: Merge after final exact-head review/CI because the branch preserves public `/healthz`, covers in-process restart, and directly addresses the observed zombie outage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway runtime/shutdown history makes steipete the best available owner for accepting or narrowing this production lifecycle contract.
